connector.name: Lexvibe
connector.registryDescription: One-step legal compliance for vibe-coded apps: privacy, terms, cookie banner and EU AI Act check.
connector.summary: Hosted at golexvibe.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the marcosnovo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: LEXVIBE_APP_ID
env.description: Your LexVibe app id (used in the installed snippet and API calls). Optional: if unset, tools ask for the id explicitly and warn about the placeholder.

env.name: LEXVIBE_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the LexVibe API. Only needed for self-hosting / development.

env.name: LEXVIBE_CDN_URL
env.description: Base URL the widget script is served from. Only needed for self-hosting / development (defaults to the LexVibe CDN, or to LEXVIBE_API_URL when that is set).

env.name: LEXVIBE_EVENTS_URL
env.description: Endpoint that receives anonymous tool-usage events (mcp_tool_call) for the Platform analytics. Defaults to the LexVibe events endpoint (or LEXVIBE_API_URL + /api/events when LEXVIBE_API_URL is set). Only needed for self-hosting.

env.name: LEXVIBE_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to 0/false/off to disable anonymous usage telemetry. DO_NOT_TRACK=1 is also honored.
